prompt: Not every bottle is friendly. Add a `PoisonConsumable` with a `Damage int` field that implements `Consumable`. Using it is an `ItemAction` like the potion; `Activate` deals `Damage` to the consumer via `Fighter.SetHP`, logs `You drink the <name>... it was poison! You lose <n> HP.` in `colorEnemyAtk`, and consumes the item. It is never `Impossible`.
